Decolonial reparative Pokémon Go with an NFT marketplace designed to benefit the communities creating and represented by the art.
Ucity makes civic engagement, authentic, transparent, and fun by using augmented reality to allow citizens to visualize future architectural projects and incentivizing them to vote.

AI storytelling tool that helps people create immersive stories from scratch.

Collaborate with your therapist to build, visualize & analyze the story of your life on a 3d timeline with Impact Moments to bring better understanding and healing. Easily access common therapy tools.
ExtraMile pairs brain wave data and AR to generate a virtual running companion that motivates users while exercising. Through gamification and competition, ExtraMile makes fitness more fun for all.
Experience a brief burst of fitness to help understand your relative fitness level. This experience has you try a few exercises and measures your performance.
Terrariam is a unique, holographic experience of a user's emotional state by measuring real-time emotional data.
A communal AR project to build interactive monuments and share participant memories of significant places. Participants deposit customized stones on AR cairns based around local communities.
A tool that empowers anyone who communicates through text or image in a 2D medium. From artists to advertisers, TypeHall brings any poster to life in the form of an adaptive audiovisual layout.
Generating digital clothing based on a user's mood, environment and social interactions. Capturing multimodal sensory info, we'll visualize relationships and interactions with digital fashion and AR.
A Snapchat filter that reads peoples emotive state. Can be used for people who have difficulty socializing, and have a hard time reading people. Could also help people with disassociation disorders.
SolSpace Gallery is a virtual world that offers NFT collectables and showcases the winning hack projects each year via VR and WebVR.
AR Sonic Painter lets the user 'grab' sound objects and move them within an AR space, composing/mixing sound visually.

Become more engaged in your workplace environment by reframing your thoughts, controling your breath and distracting your brain to feel more confident to be You and share your ideas.
A platform where people can interact with their Artist in virtual events and spaces while they are giving small fee for charity or beneficial projects.
Step by Step is a geolocated AR guide to historical Black and Indigenous Communities. It features stories told by avatars representing real people who lived there. NFT collectibles are available.
LettingGo assists in relieving anxiety & past experiences through inspiring, meditative poetry. A personalized dissipating lantern provides a physically fleeting catalyst to bring peace to the mind.
Aiming at developing interactive AR content to help with educating people about different interpretation of behaviors across cultural identities and promote cultural inclusion.

real-time conversion American Sign Language hand gesture prediction, recognition and real-time conversion to text that pops up above their avatars for Deaf and Hard of Hearing (DHH) for cross platform communications
Blõm is an otherworldly meditation Snap Lens for the Spectacles and Snap mobile app where people can come as they are and breathe with enchanting visuals and peaceful tunes. Come breathe with Blõm!
An assistive technology that helps people with ADHD overcome forgetfulness.
Imagine reading a Marine Biology book surrounded by corals, while fishes swim around you as you flip each page within underwater waves, & find definitions, research & 3D visuals with a simple touch.

Reinventing the storefront using augmented reality

column1: Flow - an MR + Brain Tracking Burnout Prevention App
column2: A mixed-reality (MR) wellness app to help employees manage and prevent burnout with automatic sensing of brainwave data and personalized wellness experiences
An introduction to quantum computing using a no-code interface. Players build experiments through a guided process and "learn by doing".
Project Hygge is a data-driven research tool that will transform how world builders make design decisions and foster inclusivity in virtual spaces (VR/AR).
Play as a cat or a keeper to accomplish your goal of either escaping your room or keeping the cats inside the room, respectively. The keeper is a quest VR experience while the cats play on PC.
A contemporary VR exhibition that preserves reality in a reality blurring ritual. It raises awareness about the current hostile situation in Ukraine and is for anyone afraid to speak about the war.
Hand Sounds is an audio-visual AR experience that raises awareness of the user's data profile through playful and immersive generative interactions.

column1: reach out and i will be there
column2: reach out and i will be there is a charmed technological object designed as a visceral conduit between people separated by time/distance. Volumetric footage, hand tracking, and holographic display.
Fusion of the classic Snake game + Wordsearch puzzle, this cognitive brain training exercise game helps treat ADHD and Dyslexia symptoms.
XR Games to help people with Learning Disabilities. We are addressing the problems that people with these disabilities (like ADHD) have, and help them overcome their weaknesses while having fun.
What kind of world do you imagine living in 10 years from now? Through this immersive VR experience, we hope to leave you with a choice and a new perspective on the world we are living in right now.
TABL3 is a new and immersive front-end UI for visualizing blockchain transactions and interacting with crypto assets.
Inspired by personal experiences of family members with Alzheimer's, we are using various forms of storytelling to promote empathy through memory loss simulations in AR/VR.
Pitch Trainer turns the tedious parts of learning music into something fun, lowering the barriers to a deeply rewarding experience that many people dream of, but never actually do.
An embodied emotional awareness experience…between people or for self reflection…So when we're together in-person we may be more present and aware of others & ourselves
Use Spectacles and Lens Studio to create a fun app for workstations. When you are tired of work, feel free to doodle anything and see what is the suggestion game and play it!! :)))
Build an XR experience in less time than it takes to download Unity ;)
Toolkit for Digital Creators to build Interactive Non Fungible Tokens and display them in Looking Glass with Leap motion and without the need for code.
A guided AR acupressure experience that promotes traditional healing therapy as a simple everyday well-being routine.

An AI holographic avatar that you can ask a question to about how people in a geographic region feel about a current event and it does a sentiment analysis of local social media to give you an answer.

column1: Harbit - Building good habits with Snap's AR Spectacles
column2: The quality of our lives depends on the quality of our habits. We've created a seamless experience for users to build and maintain good habits via Snap's AR Spectacles.
